subject: Interview Invitation: Staff Distributed Systems Engineer at Stripe
snippet: Hi Alex, we were impressed by your background in consensus algorithms and database migrations...
body:
Hi Alex,

Hope you are having a productive week. We reviewed your application for the Staff Distributed Systems Engineer opening on our Storage Infrastructure team and were very impressed with your work scaling event ingestion and distributed consensus.

We would love to invite you to an introductory 45-minute technical conversation with our Engineering Director.

Could you please share 2-3 times that work best for you over the next few business days?

Best regards,
Marcus Vance
Technical Talent Partner | Stripe Global

subject: Next Steps - Cloudflare Edge Platform Team
snippet: Hello Alex, thanks for your patience. The engineering hiring team would like to move forward...
body:
Hello Alex,

Thank you for applying to our Principal Platform & Edge Infrastructure role. The team reviewed your background in network systems and eBPF telemetry with great enthusiasm.

Before scheduling our system design round, could you confirm your current target compensation range and earliest available start date?

Looking forward to hearing from you,
Elena Rostova
Executive Engineering Recruiter
